userDefinedCodeListEntries.entryDescription: The parking charge before fees, taxes, and reductions.
A per-transaction fee the payment channel adds (an app, a text-to-pay vendor).
A service fee the operator adds (valet, reservation).
Tax on the charge, when itemized.
A reduction other than a validation (a promotion, a negotiated rate); a negative value.
A validation applied to the ticket (Part 20); a negative value.
